findings.message: MAC-array tile utilization bound 16% (Cout=10, K=64, array 64x64)
findings.suggestion: Cout=10 fills 16% of 64 columns -> prune/pad Cout to a multiple of 64 (or pick a narrower array)

findings.message: first conv has K=27 (Cin=3) -> only 42% of 64 array rows are busy
findings.suggestion: space-to-depth the input (e.g. 2x2 -> Cin=12, K=108) or accept it: it is usually a small share of total cycles

findings.message: batch-1 fully-connected layer is a GEMV: memory-bound on weights, array mostly idle
findings.suggestion: fine for small heads; for large heads keep weights on-chip or batch requests
